program.name: NIAT Upskilling Program
program.description: An industry-oriented technology upskilling initiative offered in collaboration with participating universities and colleges.
program.disclaimer: NIAT is not a university or degree-awarding body.
program.admission: Admission to a collaborating university is separate from enrollment in the NIAT upskilling program. Each university applies its own admission policies.

nat.name: NAT
nat.purpose: Assess cognitive abilities and suitability for the NIAT upskilling program.
steps: Submit the NAT application and pay the registration fee.
nat.note: NAT is not a university entrance examination.

eligibility.note: Eligibility for university admission must be confirmed separately with the university.

institutions.name: Chalapathi University
institutions.transportation: Available according to the NIAT campus page
institutions.uniform: Mandatory according to the NIAT campus page
